sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: Arium Comfort I product information: dual water grade output, iJust software, and TOC performance.
body: Arium Comfort I produces both ASTM Type 1 ultrapure water and Type 3 pure water from a single system, connected directly to a potable feed water source.
Type 1 water dispenses at rates up to 2 L/min, with quality that exceeds ASTM Type 1 specifications, not just meets them.
Type 3 pure water production runs at either 8 or 16 L/h, depending on the RO module configuration selected.
The system uses the latest reverse osmosis technology alongside a unique ion-exchange cartridge, consistently delivering purified water of the highest reproducible quality.
Intelligent iJust software makes the best use of water resources: enhancing purified water quality, reducing overall water usage, and calculating optimal cleaning cycles automatically.
Purified water is stored in the unique, closed Arium Bagtank system, reliably protecting it from secondary contamination and ensuring consistently reproducible results.

A 185/254 nm UV lamp, available as an option, prevents microbiological growth and minimizes TOC, bringing levels under 2 ppb; an optional TOC monitor checks and displays readings continuously in real time.
A touch-function display with clearly structured menu navigation ensures error-free control with a light touch, even while wearing lab gloves.
Installation adapts to available lab space: benchtop, wall-mounted, or built-in configurations are all supported.

sections.title: One System, Two Water Grades
sections.description: Most labs need both ultrapure water for sensitive analytical work and pure water for routine tasks like glassware rinsing or feeding an autoclave. Running two separate systems for that means double the footprint, double the maintenance, and double the feed connections. Arium Comfort I collapses that into one system, connected directly to a potable feed water source and producing both grades from the same unit. Type 1 water reaches up to 2 L/min at a quality that exceeds ASTM Type 1 specifications, while Type 3 output runs at 8 or 16 L/h depending on whether the system is configured with one or two RO modules. That Type 3 output also serves a quiet but valuable secondary role: purifying the feed water used to supply other ultrapure water systems downstream, extending their operational life.

sections.title: iJust: Smarter Water Management
body: Conventional water systems run on fixed schedules and generic settings, wasting water and shortening system life in the process. iJust software takes a genuinely intelligent approach instead.
It enhances purified water quality actively, rather than holding it at a static baseline, while simultaneously reducing overall water usage across daily operation.

Optimal cleaning cycles get calculated automatically by the software itself, removing the guesswork, and the risk of over- or under-cleaning, from routine maintenance. The combined effect extends beyond convenience: guaranteed longer life for downstream ultrapure water systems that rely on Comfort I's output as feed water.

sections.title: Three Technologies, Two Water Grades
sections.description: Reverse osmosis handles the bulk removal first, taking dissolved salts, organics, and particulates out of the potable feed before anything downstream has to deal with them. Patented electrodeionization then polishes continuously without regeneration chemicals, holding purity steady rather than degrading between service intervals the way a resin-only system does. The ion-exchange cartridge with highly efficient resin provides the final polish that takes water to ASTM Type 1 rather than stopping at Type 2. Because the stages run in sequence rather than as separate machines, Type 2 water is available at 5 or 10 L/h for bulk work while Type 1 dispenses at 2 L/min for analytical work — from the same unit, on the same feed line. Adding the 185 | 254 nm UV lamp puts organic reduction and microbial control into the same step: 185 nm breaks organics down to bring TOC below 2 ppb, 254 nm suppresses microbiological growth. Feeding autoclaves, glassware washers, and downstream ultrapure systems with this Type 2 water extends their working life, since scale and fouling are what usually shorten it.

sections.title: iJust and Water Economy
body: A purification system that runs fixed cleaning cycles rejects water on a schedule, whether or not the membrane condition actually calls for it. That reject water is a real, recurring operating cost.
iJust calculates optimal cleaning cycles from actual system condition instead, so cleaning happens when it's needed rather than when a timer says so.
The same software reduces overall water usage compared with conventional systems, which matters most where feed water is metered, restricted, or expensive.
Product water quality improves alongside that economy — iJust enhances purified water quality rather than trading purity for consumption savings.

Downstream ultrapure systems fed by this water are guaranteed longer life, because consistent feed quality is what determines how hard their own consumables have to work. The closed bagtank protects that carefully produced water after the fact, so quality achieved at production isn't lost to airborne contamination in storage.
